purpose: Teach: キュウリ/とうもろこし/にっこり/ガソリンスタンド/ホームセンター/クラスメート/うっすら/気さく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、給食で、本気で、絶対、キュウリ、絶対、サラダ、絶対、出たよね
lines.en: Riku, we seriously had cucumber salad at lunch again, didn't we?
lines.style: Bright, animated openness. Quick rhythm, almost teasing. The ease of someone stating the obvious to make him laugh.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。文化祭で、本気で、絶対、とうもろこし、絶対、焼くんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. And at the cultural festival we're grilling corn, for real this time.
lines.style: Matching her energy with quiet certainty. Slight lean into the promise of it. Not boasting — sharing something he's actually looking forward to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、にっこり、絶対、写真、絶対、撮ろうよ、リク
lines.en: You have to let me get a photo of you smiling like an idiot, okay Riku?
lines.style: Pushing forward with genuine warmth underneath the teasing. Quick, no apology in it. The directness of someone who knows he won't say no.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、ガソリンスタンド、絶対、自転車で、絶対、寄ったぜ、桜
lines.en: My dad actually stopped at a gas station on his bike the other day, Sakura.
lines.style: Slight shift inward — noticing something small and true. Delivered almost to himself first, then shared. Gentle, observational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活の備品、本気で、絶対、ホームセンター、絶対、お母さんと、絶対、買いに行ったよ、リク
lines.en: I went to the home center with my mom to buy stuff for the club, Riku.
lines.style: Resuming the casual rhythm. Matter-of-fact, almost purposeful — she's telling him because it matters that he knows the small things she does.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 新しい、本気で、絶対、クラスメート、絶対、優しいんだぜ、桜
lines.en: This new classmate of ours is actually really kind, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Like he's been noticing something and finally saying it out loud. Warm but careful — not overstating it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、うっすら、絶対、緊張、絶対、するよね、リク
lines.en: You get a little nervous before exams though, don't you, Riku?
lines.style: Softer touch here — gentle observation wrapped in teasing. She's checking in without making it obvious. Wry but not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 担任の先生、本気で、絶対、気さくで、絶対、相談、絶対、しやすいんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Our homeroom teacher is actually approachable and easy to talk to about things, Sakura.
lines.style: Firmness in it — the kind of thing he's learned matters. Warm, almost confiding. Like he's telling her something that made a difference.
